die.source: no free die photo found; NVIDIA's GTC17 module render shows the die but in perspective with stylised content, so no aspect or block boxes are claimed.

blocks.source: NVIDIA GTC17 render (rectified by eye): two horizontal bands of SRAM-like blocks, each with a central hub, between rows of SM tiles, i.e. the same organisation as the GA100 photo. Not measured.
NVIDIA render: SerDes-like I/O rows along one short edge only.

edges.note: HBM 2+2 on the long edges is consistent across render, package photos and the GP100 predecessor.

package.hbm_placement: 2 per side along the die long edges
package.source: NVIDIA V100 SXM2 module render (GTC17) and product photos

transistors.source: NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU Architecture whitepaper (2017): 21.1 B transistors, 815 mm2, TSMC 12 nm FFN; Hot Chips 29 slide 2 says '21B transistors, 815 mm2'

node.source: NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU Architecture whitepaper (2017): 21.1 B transistors, 815 mm2, TSMC 12 nm FFN

notes: Searched Wikimedia Commons, Fritzchens Fritz's CC0 set, Kurnal Insights' gallery, TechPowerUp, NVIDIA blogs and Hot Chips decks: no GV100 die photo with a usable licence/geometry. Fritz/Kurnal have GP100/GA100 but not GV100.
kiln_disagreements: v100_sxm2_32gb.json5: NVLink S / PCIe N; the render shows I/O only on one short edge.
L2: the render suggests two L2 bands between SM rows (GA100-like), not one block below all GPCs.
